suggestions: I'm grateful for the CI pipeline going green on the first try, no debugging required.
I'm thankful for my mom keeping a plate of nasi lemak warm even though I got home late again.
I'm grateful for the five minutes before Subuh when the flat is dead quiet and nothing needs my attention yet.
I'm thankful for a senior dev who actually walked me through the legacy code instead of just telling me to figure it out.
I'm grateful for teh o ais limau on a day the office aircon decided to give up.
I'm thankful for finally figuring out why staging kept crashing at 2am, three nights in a row.
I'm grateful for the LRT actually showing up on time this morning.
I'm thankful for my payslip clearing on the dot, no delays this month.
I'm grateful for whoever wrote decent documentation for the API I had to integrate today.
I'm thankful for the rain that cooled things down right as I stepped out for iftar prep.
I'm grateful for a code review that caught a nasty bug before it hit production and ruined my weekend.
I'm thankful for my cat curling up next to the laptop while I debug, even when she sits on the keyboard.
I'm grateful for a Friday where I actually made it to the mosque before the khutbah started.
I'm thankful for group chat friends who still check in on me even though everyone's buried in work.
I'm grateful for ten quiet minutes on the balcony with coffee before the Slack notifications start pouring in.
